response.text: The `tpl_python_package` project provides a Python package designed to separate core logic from input and output operations. Its main logic resides within `app/core.py::core`, while `app/__init__.py::init` serves as the primary package entry point. By keeping the modules in `app/__init__.py` free of input and output, the package ensures its components can be directly called and validated by its single test file.
